measurement.overall: Nine pinned gpt-5.6-luna medium first-attempt series have 80 designated records. Native turn.completed and usage appear in all 80 case records; one R3 identity response was rejected by the adapter. No replay/stub or observed forbidden source/gold tool access was found. Fixture cleanup is recorded for all 80. Source QA, frozen input hashes, launch/terminal guards and candidate snapshots support provenance, subject to R3 development wrapper failure and sampling limits.

R2 uses 12 old development, 12 fresh-topic holdout and four old-event followups. R3 uses 12 old development, six fresh-topic holdout and two old-event followups. R4 uses 24 known regression, six changed fresh-topic holdout and two old-event followups. Changed topics do not support a controlled statistical improvement claim.
Current working estimate is 2 GiB, not an enforced OS quota; unknown sample bytes must remain unknown. Full DEV-137 compliance is not established.
R3 C02 has a successful native terminal and usage but its malformed identity was rejected before apply; this is a model/validator quality failure, not provider transport failure.
